verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a REST Workflows API for launching single and bulk contract workflows from published templates (template IDs are obtainable via API). Integrations can write structured data and read or update contract documents, and approval and signature routing is handled through the workflow, with embeddable signature and clickwrap flows. Caveats: templates must first be built and published in the Workflow Designer UI, and the API requires a paid add-on. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the field-population payload and of a programmatic send-for-signature step, no published OpenAPI spec, no independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven document generation.
